answer: Require each identity to escrow a 560-unit bond and serve a twenty-nine epoch probation. Each round it finishes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for twelve rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 560 units per alias and replays twenty-nine rounds, while an oasis of linked traces exposes the ring, jade receipts prove authorship, and bridge records tie each review to its task.
